meaning: The ordered builder steps that recreate the selected body manifest (robot/design.json body_manifest) from the per-section outputs and pinned inputs. Each step reads the previous manifest; some edit it in place. Commands run from the repository root (or from the isolated copy made by robot/body/bom/rebuild_chain.py). Paths are repository-relative. Read by robot/body/bom/rebuild_chain.py and by the BOM tooling.

section_inputs.note: Outputs of the per-section builders (leg, arm, neck-head, torso) that step 1 reads. They are not rebuilt by this chain; the isolated copy links them read-only from the main checkout. Rebuilding them is a separate, earlier chain per section.

steps.notes: Also reads every native_step / mesh named by the section manifests (old artifacts/cove50-strength/... paths resolve through infra/storage/path-moves.json). Compiles robot/electronics/power/cad/zbuffer_renderer.cpp for its renders. Every data output (assembly-parts.json, parts/, bom.json, verification report, manifest.json) is written before the final render phase; on 2026-11-20 the render phase went past 6 GB (peak 6.24) and memguard stopped it after the data was complete.
Official ST3025 STEP from artifacts/robot/actuators. robot/body/motor-refit/package.py (GLB, skeleton STEP, renders) is presentation only; no later step reads its outputs, so it is not in the chain.

Env APE_OUT / APE_UPPER / APE_FOREARM / APE_SHELL_PASS only for variants; defaults are the selected build. robot/body/ape-proportions/ (build.py, hips.py, elbow_flip.py, cap_trim.py, shells.py) is not in Git (untracked, no history) on 2026-11-20, and build.py / hips.py / elbow_flip.py / cap_trim.py were modified 05:35-06:22 on 2026-11-15, after the selected assembly-parts.json (05:07). 2026-11-20 rerun: memguard 6 GB stopped it at 6.02 GB after 191 s, during the in-process gmsh surface meshes (surface_mesh.step_to_closed_mesh) of the hip pitch-to-roll sleeves STEP, before assembly-parts.json was written. 12 GB cap: at 6 GB memguard stopped build.py while gmsh meshed the hip pitch-to-roll sleeves STEP (2026-11-20); shells.py documents 12 GB. Approved by the owner 2026-11-20.

Voxel sweep of the hip and ankle target ranges; the script's docstring runs it under memguard --limit-gb 12 (not applied here: the chain runs every step at the memguard default unless a step's limit is approved). shells.py was modified 2026-11-15 06:47, after the selected shell-pass manifest (06:44). 12 GB cap: at 6 GB memguard stopped build.py while gmsh meshed the hip pitch-to-roll sleeves STEP (2026-11-20); shells.py documents 12 GB. Approved by the owner 2026-11-20.
New Stage 4 / Stage 5 roll-flip connectors (B-rep) and sleeves; imports the thigh shell's SURF skin from robot/body/leg/thigh_shell.py.

Bootstrap pass: ankle_coupler_screws.py build reads the coupler from this manifest, and this manifest swaps in the coupler that build writes (circular). Without records.json it keeps the unedited coupler and prints a WARNING.
Edits the coupler STEP named by the roll-flip manifest. Not idempotent if that manifest already carries the edited coupler (it would edit the edited part), hence the bootstrap pass before it.
Rewrites the variant from the shell-pass manifest with the edited coupler swapped in and the hip / coupler screws generated from their defined holes.

Replaces the four thigh hard covers with the blue thigh shells (THIGH_SHELL_MANIFEST / THIGH_SHELL_OUT redirect it). Surface parameters SURF are code constants; fit-surface is not part of the rebuild.
Trims the lower leg's back hard cover over KNEE_RANGE and re-mounts it with PA2x8 screws.

not_in_chain.robot/body/motor-refit/ankle_coupler_scr: patches an existing variant in place; the roll-flip-manifest step does the same swap when records.json exists
not_in_chain.robot/body/arm/shoulder_clevis.py: writes a separate candidate (artifacts/robot/body/arm/shoulder-clevis/assembly-parts-shoulder-u.json), not the selected manifest
